scenarios.scenario-1: A 150-module project sharded into 3 indexes: lint 0 findings, module list sees all 150, runCiGate 0 findings, lint under 2 s.
scenarios.scenario-2: Count mismatch, cross-shard duplicate id, href traversal and missing shard file each produce their stable coded finding; strict readers throw a typed error.
scenarios.scenario-3: module shard --apply is deterministic and idempotent (byte-identical re-run) and --dry-run writes nothing.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text output and JSON envelopes are asserted by the tests; intrinsic shard readers emit no runtime log markers.

notes.note-1: Covered by test/grace-shard.test.ts (10 tests: 150-module/3-shard proof + timings, five negative shard-validation cases, generator dry-run/apply/idempotency, strict loader semantics).
notes.note-2: Finding codes: SHARD_COUNT_MISMATCH, DUPLICATE_INDEX_ENTRY (cross-shard), PATH_UNSAFE (href traversal), SHARD_FILE_MISSING, SHARD_ROOT_INVALID, INDEX_TOO_LARGE (per-shard cap), XML_INVALID.
notes.note-3: CLI surface: mygrace inspect module shard [--group-by type|status|prefix] [--apply | --dry-run] [--path .] [--format text|json].
